bullets.bullet_text: Implemented SOC 2-aligned AWS controls for regulated insurers adopting analytics and ML capabilities, establishing a governance-ready compliance baseline for cloud-native data platforms.
Re-architected insurer underwriting and operational systems for high availability and real-time operations, strengthening resilience of core regulated workloads.
Built a shared-responsibility operating model defining insurer-owned controls versus AWS-managed controls to govern regulated cloud adoption.
